newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: DataTec annualised 13 month unit up 110 pct.
newsitem.headline: DataTec annualised 13 month unit up 110 pct.

text.p: 13 months ended March 31 versus year to February 29
Share of associates' loss 1.01 vs nil

NOTE - Electronics group DataTec said that while its Internet and Telecommunications division continues to require substantial investment, the group will continue to retain attributable income without a dividend distribution to shareholders. It said this policy will be reconsidered once the division is generating profit and positive cash flow.
Datatec issued a further cautionary saying it was involved in talks which could affect the company's share price if successful.

The group said it remained optimistic about its prospects. It said markets in South Africa and the UK continued to show robust demand for the products and services which the group offers. It said it expected continued strong grwoth in its operations and earnings.
